description: This file defines the Adapter interface used for mapping between adaptable objects and Jsonifiable types in the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter project. It declares methods for converting objects, retrieving supported groups, channels, criteria, and actions, and includes default implementations for some methods.

classes.name: Adapter
classes.description: An interface that maps objects of type T extending Jsonifiable to Adaptable objects and vice versa, supporting various channel, group, criteria, and action retrieval methods.

methods.name: fromAdaptable
methods.description: Converts an Adaptable object to its corresponding T type.

methods.name: toAdaptable (default)
methods.description: Convenience method that maps T to Adaptable using the TWIN channel.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts a T object to an Adaptable object using a specified channel.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Returns the set of groups supported by this adapter.

methods.name: getChannels
methods.description: Returns the set of channels supported by this adapter.

methods.name: getCriteria
methods.description: Returns the set of criteria supported by this adapter.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns the set of actions supported by this adapter.

methods.name: getSearchActions
methods.description: Returns the set of search actions supported by this adapter; defaults to an empty set.

methods.name: isForResponses
methods.description: Indicates whether this adapter is for responses.

methods.name: requiresSubject
methods.description: Indicates whether a subject in the topic is required; defaults to false.
